before: The document automation API listed tracked changes only per story and had no way to reach a review item by its key.
after: Range.revisions lists the changes a range overlaps, and its acceptAll and rejectAll resolve them. getReviewItemRevisions and getReviewItemRange resolve a review key to its changes or its range.
reason: Reads add no shared state. Range- and key-scoped decisions emit the same canonical revision resolution operations as existing selected-set decisions, so released participants apply them unchanged. Review keys derive from shared document state and resolve the same item on every replica.
